text: Breya was a Nord warrior and explorer who sought the Lexicon at the Dwemer Ruin of Avanchnzel. The expedition included Breya, From-Deepest-Fathoms, Watches-The-Roots, and Drennen. During the expedition she was killed by Dwarven Centurions.
Breff the Elder was a Atmoran warrior. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions. He had a war-wife, Greyf, who were both part of the Krilot Lok crew.
Bradil Elarven is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Bralsea Seloth is a Dunmer Assassin who resides in the slaver cave of Hinnabi.

Bratheru Oran is a Dunmer nightblade and Retainer-ranked member of House Hlaalu. He can be found in the waistworks of Vivec's Hlaalu Canton, where he offers his services as a spell merchant at Edryno Arethi's House.
Brathus Dals is a Dunmer merchant who resides in Morrowind. He works at the No Name Club in Vivec City.
Bravora Relavel is a Dunmer enforcer residing in Zenarbael. She is hostile towards the Nerevarine, so she will attack them at sight.

Braynas Hlervu is a Dunmer pauper residing in Ald'ruhn. He can be found standing next to his house. Due to his strained financial situation, he had to give away a prized family heirloom, the Hlervu Locket.
Brelar Andas is a Dunmer rogue and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Brelayne Verano is a Dunmer assassin residing in the cave of Ashir-Dan.
Brelda Quintella is a Dunmer witchhunter residing in Ald Daedroth, Antechamber.
Brelo Athelvis is a Dunmer warrior and member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Brelyn Indarys is a Dunmer battlemage and smuggler, and resides in the cave of Mannammu.
Brelyna Andoril is a Dunmer who resides in Yassu Mine in Morrowind.

Brerama Selas is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. He is in Shishi with two other members of House Redoran to eliminate members of House Telvanni who recently set up an outpost in the area. Brerama is accompanied by Temis Romavel and Anise Romoran.
Brerayne Raloran is a Dunmer Pilgrim and member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Brethas Deras is a Dunmer who can be found in the Elven Nations Cornerclub within the Hlaalu Canton, Morrowind.
Breves Omoril is a Dunmer bandit who resides in the cave of Kunirai.
Brevosi Indalen is a Dunmer rogue who resides in the Plaza of the Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Breyns Randas is a Dunmer Noble and member of House Hlaalu who resides on the Arvel Plantation.

Bravil Jailor is an Imperial guard in the dungeons of Bravil castle. He guards the prison and make sure all of the prisoners do not become escaped convicts. There are two of them, one doing the day shift and the other doing the night shift.

Bran is a dog, and a member of the Dawnguard, encountered in . Bran, along with Sceolang, can be found around the dog pen inside Fort Dawnguard. Bran, just like Sceolang, wears leather armor and can be used as a war dog, and companion, but only if the Dragonborn has joined the Dawnguard.

Bralsa Drel is a Dunmer miner found at the Earth Stone, outside Raven Rock. When initially encountered, she is constantly working on the structure around the Earth Stone; she talks and acts like she has been indoctrinated, just like the other people around the stone.
Bregor the Cremator is a named skeleton residing in the Ebrocca crematorium in the Shivering Isles.
Brallion is a Bosmer smuggler found on the lower level of Fara's Hole in the Wall in Sadrith Mora on the island of Vvardenfell.

Brazollus Dor was the Emperor of the Reman Empire after Reman Cyrodiil II and before Reman Cyrodiil III. Dor had generally little interest in matters of the state, and was not considered a particularly capable ruler, preferring to spend most of his time in his county estate near Skingrad. He assigned most of his duties to his Potentate, Sidri-Ashak, which is often seen as his one wise decision since Ashak proved to be a gifted administrator.
Bredros is a Bosmer farmer residing in Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.
Brela Bienne is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is found outside the Temple of the Divines. He is representing Zenithar.
Branded-Heart is an Argonian residing in the town of Davon's Watch, Stonefalls.
Brengor is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in Eyevea.
Brelaca Sadri is a Dunmer noble residing inside the Dres House in Mournhold.
Boussa is a Redguard merchant residing in the city of Sentinel.
Braladar Thimalvel is a Dunmer residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Bralos Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Branson is a character in who can be found in Broken Wing I. He is searching for his family, who were captured by bandits.
Bravosil Areloth is a Dunmer bard residing in Quarantine Serk. Bravosi is a bard-class character, however he does not sing or perform. He has no unique dialogue.
Bralos Drothro is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Bovis Andrano is a Dunmer commoner fishing at the Bal Foyen Dockyards prior to the quest "Crossroads". The Vestige will be unable to interact with him after Crossroads.
Braghul is an Orsimer chef who works at The Parchment & Horn, in the city of Marbruk, Greenshade.
Brand-Ra is an Argonian residing in the Hollow City, Coldharbour.
Branir Frostheart is a Nord found inside her house in Riften.
Brara Hlaalo is a Dunmer guild trader in . He sells his wares at his kiosk at The West Step Stalls in Daggerfall.

Brauti Bloodshark is a Nord in and is the leader of the Bloodsharks and a former member of Captain Linwen's crew. He led the mutiny against her, and can now be found deep inside the Cave of Broken Sails in Grahtwood, Valenwood.
Bravynor is a Dunmer mystic and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Vulkhel Guard.
Braxek is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan and part of the boss trio encountered at the end of Old Sord's Cave.
Brea Snowrider is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact investigating a hidden Lion Guard camp found in The Rift.

Bredin is a Nord and a member of The Companions. He is initially found at Fallowstone Hall, where him and the rest of The Companions are attempting to retake the place from the Rageclaw Clan. He is later found with the Ebonheart Pact forces at Honrich Tower.
Brelor is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild studying the Falinesti Faithful at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Brelyn is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Riften.
Brelynd Verano is a Dunmer found near the ruins of Anga. She can be found with Enak, who is having difficulty accessing the ruins' interior.
Brewmaster Rareel is an Argonian brewer residing in Haj Uxith, Coldharbour.
Breca Red-Scar is a character residing in the Tedas House in the town of Narsis.
Bravaria Dalothran is a Dunmer priestess found in the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Breves Girethi is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.
Brendngul is a Nord residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Braithayidra is a Redguard found in the east halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Breynic Othan is a Dunmer patron of the Mudcrab and Suds in Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Brema is a Dunmer assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
Breda is a Nord New Life Herald residing in a tent south of Windhelm during the New Life Festival. She is the primary source of information about the festival.
Bovoril Romalen is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at Fort Virak.
Brevasu Helothan is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Kagesh Tribe. She is found at their camp near Iliath Temple.
Bralyn Delms is a Dunmer noble residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Brasla Ilnith is a wounded Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Iliath Temple.
Bemman Juncus is an Imperial residing inside his house in Kvatch.
Brelda Ofemalen is a Dunmer battlegrounds furnisher working at Battlegrounds Housing Goods within the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Brelayne Dulo is a Dunmer scholar residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell. She does not have any unique dialogue.
Breynshad Alasien is a Dunmer traveling merchant and an Ashlander. He is found wandering the Valley of the Wind region in the north of Vvardenfell. He is the owner of Lily, a pack guar.
Bravosi Felder is a Dunmer residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks within the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City.

Bravora Lerano (née Faren) is a Dunmer in . She can only be seen through the Memory Stones in Balmora's side quest "The Memory Stone." She is the wife of Gilan Lerano, and the mother of Mils Lerano and Neria Lerano. She died defending Gilan while on a contract for Master Drenim of House Telvanni.
The Brassilisk is a Snake fabricant created by Sotha Sil found across The Clockwork City, including in the the Brass Fortress and Mechanical Fundament. when killed they drop Clockwork Oscillators.
Braynas Faryon is a Dunmer scholar member of the Clockwork Apostles residing at The Cloisters inn in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.

Brennus, also known as Brenn, was an Imperial scholar during the reign of Titus Mede I. He was tasked to gather data from Umbriel before it could be a threat for the Empire. The Emperor awarded him a high military rank despite not being a warrior, days before he left the Imperial City.
Brannis is a Nord found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Brengolin is an aspiring Bosmer chef located in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.
Bretheru Daram is the stable master of the Brass Fortress in Clockwork City he runs Daram Stables.
Brerayne Hlen is a Dunmer residing in the Dwemer ruins of Nchuleftingth, Vvardenfell. She is part of Neramo's expedition team there. She has a brother Daren Hlen.
Bralsa Inlador is a Dunmer located in Pulk, Vvardenfell, in . She is the boss of the delve and killing her will mark Pulk as having been completed.

Brander Releth is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. He can be found in the western part of the starting area of the Forgotten Wastes at the dunmer stronghold. Together with Mountain-Caller Hlaren and Stone-Boiler Omalas, they are considered a group event boss of the dungeon.
Brahgas is a Bosmer Roister's Club member who introduces you to the game. <!--

Brisienna Magnessen, also known as Lady Brisienna or Lady Magnessen, is a sister of a great knight, and a high-ranking member of the Blades. She is the Grand Spymaster in the Iliac Bay region. She infiltrated the court of Daggerfall in the guise of one of the witches of Popudax.
Briras Tyravel is a Dunmer warrior and a member of House Hlaalu. He lives in his manor in Balmora.

Brildraso Nethan is a Dunmer Drillmaster and member of House Redoran. She can be located in the Redoran Waistworks portion of the Vivec, Redoran Canton. She also offers training to other members of the house.
Brother Piner is an Imperial and a member of the Order of Talos. He can be found within the Weynon House along with, Eronor, Jauffre, and Prior Maborel.

Brurid is a Nord smuggler residing in his shack in the village of Khuul. His home is relatively large in comparison to his neighbors', perhaps a hint that he makes a good living in the Moon Sugar trade, some of which can be found inside his shack.

Brotch Calus is an Imperial commoner living in Bruma who can often be found in Olav's Tap and Tack in the evening and his house in the morning and night. He is an Alchemy trainer at the Journeyman level.
Brodras is a Bosmer and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the Leyawiin Fighters Guild.
Brithaur is a Bosmer thief living in Crucible, New Sheoth. The rest of the citizens are angry with his petty thievery and want him handled.
Bruscus Dannus is an Imperial commoner living in Highcross. He is usually found cleaning the settlement's streets with a broom.
Brielus Gawey is an Imperial commoner working at the Chestnut Handy Stables, just outside the Imperial City.
Brokil gro-Shatur is an Orsimer commoner who spends all day in Silverhome on the Water in Bravil.

Bruccius the Orphan is an Imperial beggar living in Cheydinhal. His bedroll and food bag are behind The March Rider. Bruccius is one of the few beggars who can provide information on how to join the Thieves Guild, even joining the Hero for one of the quests.
Brucetus Festinius is a Breton mercenary who has been hired by Claude Maric. He and the rest of Claude's mercenaries can be found at the Roxey Inn, north of the Imperial City.
Bruscius Longus is an Imperial who is a worshiper of the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora. He can be found at the Shrine of Hermaeus Mora.
Brynjolf is a Nord thief and a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften. Brynjolf is currently the second-in-command at the Thieves Guild, below only Mercer Frey, the current Guildmaster.
Brill is a Nord who lives in Whiterun. He resides in the Companions' headquarters, Jorrvaskr, but he is not a member himself.
Britte is a Nord child and a resident of Rorikstead along with her family.
Briehl is a Nord acolyte and staunch follower of Mara in Riften.
Brother Verulus is an Imperial priest of Arkay in Markarth. He is found outside the Hall of the Dead, within Understone Keep, arguing with Thongvor Silver-Blood.
Brina Merilis is a retired Nord Legionnaire in who resides in Dawnstar. She will become Jarl of the Pale if the Legion occupies Dawnstar.

Brunl, Who Fought With His Off-Hand, was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions. Bruhl was part of the Jorrvaskr crew, commanded by Jeek of the River. After reaching Mereth and reclaiming Saarthal, Bruhl and his crew went south to the area that is now known as Whiterun Hold. They settled there, making Bruhl to be among the first people who lived in Whiterun.
Broder Garil is a Dunmer Spellsword and member of House Redoran residing in Bal Isra.
Bronosa Nedalor is a Dunmer Nightblade who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. She is a House Cousin of House Hlaalu and can be found inside Curio Manor.
Broris Fals is a Dunmer Battlemage who resides in Morrowind. He is part of the outlaw gang which inhabits Hlaalu Ancestral Vaults underneath Vivec, Hlaalu Canton.
Brothes Oran is a hostile Dunmer Agent and leader of the slavers at Aharunartus.

Britta Invel is an Imperial and professional acrobat and was invited, along with her husband, Jaras, to Castle Leyawiin by Countess Alessia Caro to entertain the guests at a dinner party. Thus, she only appears in-game after starting Sanguine's Daedric Quest.

Brother Hjar is a Nord living at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. The temple, which is tucked away in the Jerall Mountains, is the home to Blind Moth Priests who have lost their sight reading Elder scrolls. Brother Hjar, as well as brothers Holger and Hridi, assist and protect the priest.

Brother Holger is a Nord living at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. The temple, which is tucked away in the Jerall Mountains, is the home to Blind Moth Priests who have lost their sight reading Elder Scrolls. Brother Holger, as well as brothers Hridi and Hjar, assist and protect the priest.

Brother Hridi is a Nord living at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. The temple, which is tucked away in the Jerall Mountains, is the home to Blind Moth Priests who have lost their sight reading Elder Scrolls. Brother Hridi, as well as brothers Holger and Hjar, assist and protect the priest.

Bruma Investigator Guard is a character in . They can be found in Bradon Lirrian's House, in Bruma. They will be there investigating the death of Bradon Lirrian, who was murdered by Raynil Dralas as part of the quest "A Brotherhood Betrayed."

Bruma Jailor is a guard who is posted at the Bruma Jail. The Bruma jailors wear the standard Bruma guard uniform, and their specific duties are to guard the prisoners in Bruma's prison and the evidence chest the prisoners' personal items are stored in. In order for the Hero to escape prison, the guard can either be killed or be bypassed undetected.
Brusef Amelion is the grandfather of Biene Amelion. He is buried in his family tomb.
Bruscilla is a Breton who is found near the Aldcroft Mages Guild in Aldcroft, Glenumbra.
Brother Gaubert is a Breton residing in Glenumbra, High Rock. He is standing outside Bad Man's Hallows, inviting the Vestige to join the harvest festival.
Brother Perry is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens. He is encountered multiples times across Stormhaven, doing multiple tasks on account of his order.
Bryngrim is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found either in the Raven Rock Mine or wandering the wilds of the Hirstaang Forest region.
Brugdush is an Orsimer laborer who resides at The Watch House in Davon's Watch. He mainly cleans at The Watch House.
Brielus Colus is an Imperial in who is found in Cheydinhal. He is the husband of Jena Colus.
Brinarch is a Reachman of the Dark Witnesses clan found in Fallen Grotto. He drove the priests out when he took over and was granted the title of champion by Hircine himself.
Brog is an Orsimer clothier and owner of The Lonesome Loom in Belkarth.
Brolsgerbwd is a powerful Dremora found in the Risen Court. Killing her will unlock the achievement "Brolsgerbwd's Bane." They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Brother Alphonse is a Breton monk of the Spirit Wardens residing in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven.
Brother Amiberl is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens who resides in the Pariah Abbey, in Stormhaven.
Brother Doumant is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey.
Brother Fontenot is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey.
Brother Frencque is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Frizwyr is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens trying to wake their leader, Abbot Durak, from his slumber.
Brother Gastarge is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Gerard is a member of the Spirit Wardens trying to save one of his fellow warden from the grips of the Supernal Dreamers.
Brother Gilles is a Breton of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey in Stormhaven.
Brother Gordon is a Breton monk and a member of the Spirit Wardens residing in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven.
Brother Guybert is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.

Brother Hakam is a deceased Redguard found in the Pariah Abbey in Stormhaven. He was a member of the Spirit Wardens and part of Abbot Durak's team who went to retrieve water from the Cave of Dreams. He was slain by the Midnight Union on the way there.
Brother Juste is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Mogrub is a member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Morten is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens in residing in the Pariah Abbey in the region of Stormhaven. He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Muran is a member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey.
Brother Nombert is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens in found in the Pariah Abbey in Stormhaven. He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Ulagug is a member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey, Stormhaven, in . He cannot be interacted with.
Brother Zacharie is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens found in the Pariah Abbey.
Brugagikh is an Orsimer merchant and part of the group of outlaws found underneath Velyn Harbor. He runs "Grotto Gooda & Such". Author of the conspiracy manifesto Who Is REALLY In Charge?.
Bruuke is an ogre that appears in the Serpent Hollow Cave in Cyrodiil.
Brimfja is a Nord innkeeper of Skalar's Hostel, located in the outskirts of Orsinium. Brimfja is married to Skalar, yet takes care of his hostel.
Bruc Channitte is a Breton found inside the outlaws refuge beneath Orsinium.
Brunog is a Nord laborer found in Daggerfall. He is taking notes while listening to Crier Martine, just outside the Daggerfall Millworks. He has no unique dialogue.
Brucus Gurges is an Imperial member of the Thieves Guild. He is found inside the thieves den in Abah's Landing.
Brogdul is an Orsimer pack merchant running the Blood Bags in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Broder Givyn is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Kagesh Tribe. He is found at their camp near Iliath Temple.
Brolthiath is a Bosmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell. He cannot be interacted with.
Brothes is a Dunmer sailor found at the docks in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Brittgerd Bear-Master is a Nord member of the Undaunted. She is part of the group that went into the portal leading to Mehrunes Dagon's Deadlands that was opened in the City of Ash.
Brunka is a Nord and one of the many possible assassinations targets of the Smuggler's Den's contract.
Brygelva is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed at Fort Virak.
Broder Sarandas is a Dunmer bard located near an abandoned house south of the Ahemmusa Camp in the Bitter Coast, in Vvardenfell. He is the brother of Turseth Sarandas. He has no unique interactions.
Brigand Archer is a generic character residing in the Daedric Ruin of Assarnatamat, in Vvardenfell.
Brigand Beastcaller is a generic character residing in the Daedric Ruin of Assarnatamat, in Vvardenfell.
Brigand Soldier is a generic character residing in the Daedric Ruin of Assarnatamat, in Vvardenfell.
Bronzefist Arcanist are generic characters residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are members of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Bodyguard is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Marksman is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Mender is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Stalker is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Striker is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
Bronzefist Vanguard is a generic character residing in Nchuleftingth in Vvardenfell. They are a member of the Bronzefists, a hostile faction.
The Bruma Ranger is a character residing in the town of Bruma. They are protecting the city from the Daedra trying to take it over. They can be seen attacking the Daedra, resting or on patrol.
Brodran is an Bosmer in Summerset. He can be found in the greenhouse near his house halfway between the Keep of the Eleven Forces and Sil-Var-Woad Wayshrine. He is seen feeding his Alavlin Beetles.
Brother Kithral is a deceased character in . He is the author of Brother Kithral's Journal.

Brindisi Dorom, also known as Indoril Brindisi Dorom, was the Duke-Prince of Mournhold in 1E 2920. He exiled his mistress Turala once he had learned of her pregnancy. In attempting to kill his enemies in Cyrodiil, Brindisi Dorom was accused of killing Turala's coven and killed in the Sack of Mournhold. He had previously conducted slave-raids in Black Marsh and waged war against the Emperor, Reman Cyrodiil III. A plaza in Mournhold is named after him.
Brondold is a Nord encountered in Solitude and the surrounding area.
Brutius is an Elder Imperial in that is a part of the Fishing Creation Club content.
Burd is a Nord Guard Captain of the Bruma City Guard. He leads the city's guard in the Defense of Bruma during the Oblivion Crisis in 3E 433.
Burcanius Varo is an Imperial publican residing in Vos in the Grazelands. He's found in the Varo Tradehouse.

Burz gro-Khash runs the Fighters Guild in Cheydinhal and is one of the main sources of contracts for members. He wields a leveled mace. He is family friends with Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak of Lord Rugdumph's Estate, northwest of Cheydinhal. He can be found in the Guild hall or wandering the city.
Bumph gra-Gash is an Orsimer and a member of the Fighters Guild in the city Bruma.
Caelia Draconis is a Guard Captain in Leyawiin and also a member of the Imperial Legion. After she served a tour in the Legion, she settled down as a guard, to the upset of her mother.
Bur-Meema is an Argonian who prays to Azura and is always by the Shrine of Azura.
Caenlorn is a Bosmer commoner and he and his twin brother Maenlorn run The Flowing Bowl at the Anvil Dock.
Bulfrek is a Nord citizen in who works as a servant to Jarl Skald the Elder at the The White Hall, in Dawnstar.
Bugrol gro-Bagul is an Orsimer Thief who is located near the city walls of Caldera in the West Gash region, where he is hiding from the city guard out in the.

Bugdul gro-Kharbush is an Orsimer commoner found in . He is a foreman working at the site of Bal Isra where Indarys Manor is being build. He will only be present during the first phase of the quest "Redoran Stronghold."

Bujold the Unworthy, also known as "Bujold the Intrepid," is chieftain of Thirsk Mead Hall. In the tradition of Thirsk chieftains before her, she became leader after she slew the great beast of Ilfark and presented its stomach as a battle trophy.

Bulfim gra-Shugarz is an Orsimer warrior and cultist of Sheogorath residing inside the Daedric shrine of Maelkashishi. She is afflicted with the Ash-chancre disease. Curing her is part of the "Compassion" quest.

Sir Cadwell is the oldest of the soul shriven, and is a cheerful and endearingly mad lost soul. In life, he was an insane Imperial from Chorrol, and Lyris Titanborn remarks that the reason he has remained functioning for so long is because he was already mad when he got to Coldharbour. It is said that he is not afraid of anyone, not even a Daedric Prince, and resides in Coldharbour. He died by decapitation. Initially met in The Wailing Prison, he later appears in The Harborage, and later on in many locations around Coldharbour. He has a hovel setup in a Nordic ruin in the southern part of the zone.
Burub gra-Bamog is an Orsimer Barbarian residing in Ashunartes.
Burul gro-Orbuma is an Orsimer Warrior residing in Kaushtarari, on Azura's Coast.
Burzob gra-Sharbag is an Orsimer Barbarian, and a worshipper of Sheogorath residing in Zaintiraris.

Bugharz gro-Ular is an Orsimer Barbarian who resides in the region of Sheogorad located within Morrowind. He is found west of Mzuleft at a statue of Malacath with three other Orsimer, Urzog gro-Shadbuk, Glob gra-Ghasharzol, and Murzol gro-Ulfimph.
Bugrash gro-Gorzog is an Orsimer Warrior who resides in the Dwemer Ruin of Mzuleft.
Bulak gra-Murug is an Orsimer barbarian who may be found in the region of Sheogorad.

Bumbuk Bear-Slayer is an Orsimer boss and member of the Oathbound Clan found in the Obsidian Scar public dungeon. Killing her counts towards the "Champions of the Obsidian Scar" and "Terror of Obsidian Scar" achievements.
Burwa is a Redguard enchanter who resides in the city of Port Hunding on the island Stros M'Kai. She sells her wares in the indoor market Doom and Draughts.

Burtle is a dog in . He we was imported from Daggerfall by Tahara, who is showing Burtle to the citizens of Mistral. Tahara presents him as a ruffian beast. He is apparently "a killing machine," and while this is not true the reasoning for Tahara's falsehoods are not specified.
Caano is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion found at Seaside Sanctuary.
Byla Drethan is a Dunmer carpenter. She sells her wares at her stall, Drethani Carpentry, at the Artisans Craftworks in Mournhold.
Caecilus Bursio is an Imperial and the High Astrologer of the Star-Gazers. He is found at their observatory in Belkarth.
Bumava is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild residing at the local guildhall in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
Buzul is a Khajiit residing in the city of Silvenar. He is Dadazi's husband.
Budolen Fairsong is a Nord bard playing at the Pilgrim's Rest Inn, in Ivarstead. He cannot be interacted with.
Bugbesh is an Orsimer member of the Daggerfall Covenant. She is in charge of the siege range at the Southern High Rock Gate.
Bulag is a Khajiit found inside the Cave of Broken Sails. He is one of the few remaining loyal members of Captain Linwen's crew.
Bullig gro-Barbol is an Orsimer found inside Shornhelm Savings & Loan, in Shornhelm.
Bulzog is an Orsimer member of the Bitterhand Bandits holding hostages in a mill south of Fell's Run.
Bura-Natoo is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild found in Hunter's Camp on Bleakrock Isle.
Buram Fire-Hearth is a Nord brewer working at The Sober Nord Tavern in Windhelm.
Buram Savani is a Dunmer patron of The Fish Stink in Davon's Watch.
Burnscar is a Khajiit member of the Renrijra Maor. She is one of their agents infiltrated in Alten Corimont.
Buronii is a Dunmer commoner and patron of the Coin Brothers' Cornerclub in Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Burri is a Khajiit residing at the Swiftblade's Camp in Eastmarch.
Caenlilmith is a Bosmer quartermaster for the Undaunted found at the enclave in the city of Elden Root.
Caerel is an Altmer traveling merchant found on the road north of Toothmaul Gully.
Burzgrag gro-Bugurz is an Orsimer chef residing at the Caravan Company Depot, in the city of Dragonstar, Craglorn.
Bunul is a Khajiit found at Hadran's Caravan. He oversees the spikeball races there.
Byz is a Goblin member of the Toothmaul Tribe found in Toothmaul Gully. Unlike most of his kin, he is non-hostile and can speak the common tongue.
Caentholrin is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars residing in Brackenleaf.
Burzunguk is an Orsimer fence residing in the Outlaws Refuge underneath the city of Orsinium.
Bulfor the Cheesemonger is an Orsimer located near Borbgur's House in the city of Orsinium. She owns an Echatere named Wooly.
Burdog is a Nord beggar found in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing in Hew's Bane.
Buki is an Argonian innkeeper found in Anvil, Gold Coast. She runs the dockside inn Mudcrab and Suds.
Bumuzuna is a Redguard member of the Horsemen found at Silverhoof Vale in Rivenspire.
Bur-Waska is an Argonian kwama miner. He is one of the potential assassination targets assigned by Speaker Terenus at the Smuggler's Den.
Caecilia Attius is an Imperial mage found at her camp north of the Bangkorai Garrison.
Burzura is a Orsimer warrior and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in Shornhelm.
Buxtil is an Argonian found at the Renewal Lodge in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Caddach of the Blackdrake Clan, also known as the Despot of Markarth and Ard Caddach, was a Reachman who ruled Markarth and the eastern Reach during the Second Era.
Burush is an Orsimer found in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset. He is part of a group of outcasts led by Ruliel living near the ruins. He cannot be interacted with.

Camilla Lollia is a lieutenant of Mannimarco and a member of the Order of the Black Worm. She is found in the Bruma Mages Guild once it is attacked. She wears Necromancer's Robes with a pair of Pigskin Shoes. She is the fourth of Mannimarco's lieutenants to be killed.

King Camaron, sometimes misspelled as Cameron, and occasionally called The White Moon, was a King of Sentinel. From his wife, Queen Akorithi, Camaron had three sons; Greklith, Lhotun, and Aubk-i. He had one more son, Arthago, but due to the frail condition of the child, Camaron decided to eliminate the child as he felt that the boy was unfit for the throne of Sentinel. The official word is that The Underking got him.
Caius Cosades is an Imperial monk in . He is the grand spymaster of the Blades residing in the city of Balmora and head of the Blades chapter in Morrowind.

Callisos, alternatively spelled Calissos, was a bard at the Bards College in Solitude famous for touring Tamriel. In his legacy, many graduates still follow in his footsteps, along with those of Morachellis, another famous bard. After performing a beautiful love song for Sheogorath, he supposedly tricked the Daedric Prince into giving him a lyre tied to his soul—called the "Lodestone"—in exchange for his own plain lyre, which he claimed was imbued with Dibella's "raw passion." He mysteriously disappeared some time later.
Canodia Felannus is an Imperial Commoner who resides in Caldera.
Caminda is a Redguard Acrobat that dances at Desele's House of Earthly Delights in Suran. She will be found dancing next to Marelle and Runa.
Caminalda is an Altmer who spends her time in the Brina Cross Inn just outside Anvil. She is very interested and concerned in the recent merchant slayings near the Inn.
Caldana Monrius is an Imperial commoner and Skooma addict found in Crucible, in the Shivering Isles.
Candice Corgine is a Breton Publican, owner of The Sleeping Mare located in Pell's Gate. She lives in The Sleeping Mare, and sells clothing and alchemical ingredients for a living.
Captain Gepard Montrose is an Imperial Watch Guard Captain for the Imperial Prison Guards in the Imperial Prison Sewers in the Dark Brotherhood quest "Scheduled for Execution."
Canctunian Ponius is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. He is the Factor-in-chief of the East Empire Company in Morrowind.
Camilla Valerius is an Imperial pawnbroker who lives in Riverwood with her brother, Lucan Valerius. If Lucan is killed, she will take over the Riverwood Trader.

Callia Bincal is a Breton commoner taking refuge at Crestbridge Camp along with her husband Aloys, after their farm at Cropsford was ransacked by goblins. She has moved to Cyrodiil with her reluctant husband and her father, but Aloys will enjoy the move after some time on the farm.
Cania Mico is an Imperial who resides in Tel Vos. He is a hireling and serves under House Telvanni. He is also a warrior, and simply responds with "Leave me alone."

Calcelmo is an elderly Altmer Conjurer who can be found in Markarth's Understone Keep, where his nephew, Aicantar, helps him in the laboratory. He has a great interest in the Dwemer and is the author of many scholarly works about them. He claims himself to be the most praised scholar on the Dwemer on the continent.
Calixto Corrium is an Imperial shopkeeper in Windhelm. As the owner of Calixto's House of Curiosities, he offers tours of the items he and his sister collected during their travels in Tamriel.
Captain Aldis is a Nord Guard Captain of the Solitude Guard and the overseer of Roggvir's execution in who can be found in the courtyard outside Castle Dour in Solitude.
Cairine is a Breton indigent resident of The Warrens in Markarth. She wears ragged robes and ragged boots and is equipped with a simple iron dagger.
Captain Hargar is a Nord bandit from the Blackblood Marauders group.
Captain Lonely-Gale is a Nord, former sailor, and resident of Windhelm.
Captain Aquilius is the Redguard Guard Captain of the Wizard Guards hired by Calcelmo residing in Calcelmo's Tower.
Calaxes Septim was the illegitimate child of Emperor Uriel Septim VII who became the Archbishop of the One in the Imperial City.
Camandil is an Altmer Witch who can be found in the lower level of Falensarano. She is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Captain Falx Carius is an Imperial guard captain stationed at Fort Frostmoth.
Captain Evernal is former soldier under Emperor Titus Mede. He is a character within the novel The Infernal City.
Camas is a Redguard healer and worshiper of Sheogorath living in Almurbalarammi. Camas is highly aggressive and will attack on sight. He can be calmed but has no unique information.
